probing_questions: Return a classification, exact source quote, supporting source key, uncertainty and reason. For a source relationship retain its original URL and exact supporting passage. No original evidence means unknown; never fill a missing quote from memory.

problematique: Assess organizational classification and original publishing relationships from supplied institution website extracts and original source pages. Registry descriptions and names are leads, not proof. Classify a think tank only with concrete original evidence of its policy research and organizational identity; distinguish universities, government agencies, central banks, companies, unions and advocacy organizations. A mixed or ambiguous body stays unknown unless the declared scope expressly admits it. Do not infer ideology, funding influence or positions from names or countries. Quote the exact supplied passage that warrants the classification and preserve its source key. For each original publication distinguish publishing, commissioning, organizing or hosting from merely being mentioned, quoted or linked as an outside reference. A shared-platform host alone cannot establish the institution. An external PDF/video requires retained original relationship evidence. Record signed view, guest contribution, adopted statement, event participant, host question and third-party quotation separately; unknown authority stays unknown. Preserve author-views disclaimers. These are bounded classifications of supplied evidence, not findings about the research question.
researcher_question: Which organization and publishing relationship do these originals establish?
